title: IAM coverage
intro: Users, roles, policies, keys and identity providers. The console drives five
identity actions and reads access keys on the Security credentials page; everything else is
reachable over the wire and through the IAM API explorer.
`tests/control/test_iam_operations.py` drives every advertised operation through the
emulator's own query protocol and reads the state back, so the test column has no gaps.
The emulator also answers two group operations its README row omits — `ListGroups` and
`DeleteGroup` — and the suite drives those too.
The identity policies are enforced, not decoration: `tests/control/test_iam_policies.py`
then runs a matrix of users with different policies against a live lab (it skips
without one, because the in-process emulator runs with `AUTH` off).
